context: A barista and a sales rep plan replacing cafe equipment
purpose: Teach: 家電/トヨタ/メンテナンス/ポケット/オイル/サウンド/マップ/グリーン

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ユキさん、すみません、お店のエスプレッソマシン、そろそろ寿命みたいで。
lines.en: Yuki, sorry, our shop's espresso machine seems to be reaching the end of its life.
lines.style: Casual barista opening with the core problem and mild apology.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほど、定期メンテナンスの時期も過ぎてましたもんね。
lines.en: I see, it was also past due for regular maintenance, right?
lines.style: Empathetic rep confirming context before suggesting solutions.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そうなんです。グラインダーからオイル漏れもあって、騙し騙し使ってました。
lines.en: Exactly. There was even an oil leak from the grinder, so we'd been nursing it along.
lines.style: Honest barista elaborating on the equipment's deteriorating state.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ちょうど今、家電フェアでグリーン購入対象のマシンが揃ってます。トヨタ系列の補助制度も使えますよ。
lines.en: Right now our appliance fair has machines eligible for green purchasing, and you can use the Toyota-group subsidy too.
lines.style: Sales rep introducing a timely promotion tied to the customer's need.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 補助が出るなら助かります。うちのポケットマネーじゃ、正直きつかったので。
lines.en: If there's a subsidy that really helps. Honestly our out-of-pocket budget was tight.
lines.style: Relieved barista checking financial feasibility with frank honesty.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 対応店舗のマップ付き資料をお渡ししますね。サウンド設備の更新もまとめて見積もれます。
lines.en: I'll give you a brochure with a map of participating stores. We can also bundle an estimate for the sound equipment.
lines.style: Helpful rep offering tangible materials and an extended one-stop service.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それは助かります。あっさり決めたい案件なので、店長にも意向を確認しておきますね。
lines.en: That's a big help. It's something I want to decide quickly, so I'll confirm intent with the manager too.
lines.style: Cooperative barista signaling commitment and promising internal alignment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: では来週、直ちにデモ機をお持ちします。お店で実際に触ってみてください。
lines.en: Then next week, I'll bring a demo unit right away. Please try it out in the shop.
lines.style: Decisive sales rep closing with a concrete and inviting next step.
